description: A 20-minute (24 000-tick) 4v4 Cold War skirmish on an 8 km map, one lockstep client per player (8 clients), each player sending scripted orders on top of its AI commanders, over a clean 40 ms network: state hashes compared every 5 s never differ, the confirmed input log replays to the same final state, and the battle actually progresses (units deployed and destroyed).
